description: ResRefine "Load recommended settings" button lookup table (hareskip/recommended_settings.py:RECOMMENDED_SETTINGS). Matching is exact-string (sampler, scheduler); no entry means the button falls back to Reuse (residual only). use_prediction_after_progress and apply_prediction_from_skip are included in every row because the calibration campaign held both fixed for the whole campaign (STAGE5-SCAN1-HANDOFF §1) — the button reproduces the calibrated condition exactly, not just formula/strength/smoothing.
calibration_campaign: 第5段階応答曲面キャコヘーン（stage-5 response-surface campaign）, 2026-09-05 - 2026-09-14

calibration.confirmation: borderline significance — weaker evidence than Euler+Beta, kept as the best available default for this pair

known_limitations: Calibrated at N=15 skips / 30 steps only — no per-step-count or per-skip-count band exists yet (a future "skip_band" column was considered and deliberately left out as premature/YAGNI; each row is a plain dict so adding one later is a one-line change, not a schema migration).

One-shot resolution only: the button reads the host UI's sampler/scheduler/steps once, at click time. If you change the host sampler/scheduler afterwards, the extension does not notice — click the button again to re-resolve.
Matching is exact-string and case-sensitive on the sampler/scheduler display names (e.g. "Euler a" never matches the "Euler" row).

The button can be disabled entirely if the host's sampler/scheduler/steps controls were not captured for the current tab — this happens when Settings -> User interface -> Parameter order has been changed so that 'scripts' is ordered before 'sampler' (the capture callback runs at UI-build time and needs the host controls to already exist).
how_to_add_a_row: Add a dict to RECOMMENDED_SETTINGS in hareskip/recommended_settings.py with the same keys as the existing rows; import the formula constant from hareskip.state (RESREFINE_FORMULA_LINEAR / _TAYLOR2 / _REUSE) rather than using a string literal.
Document the calibration source for the new row in that module's docstring (campaign name/date range and the relevant statistic).
Update this JSON file and RECOMMENDED-SETTINGS.md with the same row.
Add a case to tests/test_recommended_settings.py covering the new (sampler, scheduler) lookup.
